tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and post background. Light value is the logo's ivory ground, sampled exactly.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, product tiles, menus and inputs that sit on surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Alternating page bands, photo placeholders and footers.

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: The brand colour, sampled from the logo's door and wordmark. Primary buttons, headings on ivory, links, and large colour fields on social posts. As text, on surface, surface-raised, forest-soft and brass-soft (7:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: forest-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of forest fills; footer and full-bleed dark bands in the light theme.

tokens.name: forest-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind forest text: selected filters, the In stock badge, quiet callouts.

tokens.name: on-forest
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a forest or forest-deep fill (8:1). Never pure white.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: The logo's ring and rule colour, sampled exactly. Decorative only: hairline rules, the seal ring, icons and dividers (3.4:1+ on surface, surface-raised and forest-soft). On a forest fill it disappears: rules there use brass-soft. Never small text in the light theme — use brass-ink.

tokens.name: brass-ink
tokens.usage: Brass as text: eyebrows, the s.a.r.l.-style spaced labels, prices. On surface, surface-raised, forest-soft and brass-soft (4.9:1+).

tokens.name: brass-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind brass-ink text: the New arrival badge, promo strips. Also the hairline colour on forest fills (forest social slides).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and dense UI on every surface and tint (11:1+).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, spec labels and metadata on every surface and tint (5.4:1+).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card edges. Decorative; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and secondary-button borders (3:1 on surface and surface-raised).

tokens.name: rust
tokens.usage: Errors and Out of stock, always with a word. As text on surface, surface-raised and rust-soft.

tokens.name: rust-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind rust text. Kept light so it differs from the filled forest In stock badge in lightness, not hue alone.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px surface gap, then a solid 2px focus ring. Alias of forest.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links, underlined. Alias of forest.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif
families.arabic: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "IBM Plex Sans", Tahoma, sans-serif

groups.name: Headings
groups.note: A slab serif that echoes the logo's heavy slab wordmark. The wordmark itself only ever appears as the logo file.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Home hero and social cover slides only; one per page or post.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Product names on cards and sub-sections.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: IBM Plex Sans for Latin text, with Plex Sans Arabic in the stack so mixed lines match.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a heading, in brass-ink. Echoes the spaced s.a.r.l. line under the logo.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Imported directly from trusted factories and stocked in Lebanon.
styles.usage: Intros under h1/h2 and hero copy.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Slim, elegant design with easy speed and force adjustment.

groups.name: Arabic
groups.note: Arabic needs taller line heights than Latin. Set lang="ar" and dir="rtl" on the containing element.

styles.name: ar-heading
styles.usage: Arabic headings and the Arabic line of bilingual product names.

styles.name: ar-body
styles.sample: إغلاق تلقائي مع إمكانية تعديل السرعة

styles.name: spec
styles.usage: Measurements, load ratings, angles and SKUs in spec tables. Western digits in both languages.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: eyebrow to heading, spec rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding (sm), list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, form field gaps, the mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, grid gutters, the desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between a section header and its content.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Social post safe margin at 1080px; between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Full-bleed photos and colour bands.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and badges — nearly square, like the door leaf.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and product images.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Only the circular seal frame and avatar crops, after the logo's ring.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Product cards on hover only. At rest, cards use a line border, not a shadow.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of page content.

tokens.name: text-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of running text and intros.

tokens.name: rule-weight
tokens.usage: Brass hairline rules and the inner seal ring, as in the logo.
